title: Kai Cenat Calls It Before Trevor Shows Up
why: Kai calls it: a sniper drops a helicopter and Trevor shows up on the roof.

title: Kai Cenat Gets Crushed by a Burning Helicopter
why: A burning helicopter crashes onto Michael; MISSION FAILED and Kai asks 'What is this RNG?'

title: Kai Cenat Reacts to the Trevor vs Michael Graveyard Standoff
why: Graveyard standoff: Trevor dares Michael to shoot, a third shot rings out, Michael dives.

title: Kai Cenat Can't Handle Tracey
why: Tracey stalls on the way to the therapist, then dives head-first into the car; Kai cannot cope.

title: Kai Cenat Jokes He'll Restart GTA if This Heist Fails
why: Heist in a tunnel: armoured trucks stopped, guards pulled out, Kai bets the whole series.
hook: If I fail this, I restart GTA

title: Kai Cenat Crashes and Loses All His Aura
why: Franklin's bike crash gives MISSION FAILED; Kai: 'All your aura, lost', then the retry loops.

title: Kai Cenat Pulls Off the Federal Building Heist
why: Kai calls the 'spy route', sneaks into the house, and the crew pulls the heist off.

title: Kai Cenat Can't Believe Franklin Missed the Roof
why: Franklin misses the FIB roof (MISSION FAILED), then a retry with a heli jump and skydive.

title: Kai Cenat Gets Stuck With the Wrong Car
why: Wrong car picked, a street brawl breaks out over a car theft; 'Nobody steals from me.'

title: Kai Cenat Watches a Helicopter Explode
why: Sniping from a hilltop, a helicopter is hit and explodes; 'What is that?'

title: A Police Chopper Spots the Crew Mid-Rappel
why: Rappelling down a tower at night, a police air unit spots the crew: 'They got a bird.'

title: Kai Cenat Wishes He Could Just Take Any Car
why: Kai riffs 'just take any car and go' as the getaway car leaves the hangar, then answers chat.
hook: Just take any car and go

title: Kai Cenat's Garbage Truck Getaway
why: Cops thin out after a shootout and Kai drives off in a garbage truck with four stars.
hook: That's how you clean this up

title: Kai Cenat Bails Out of a Burning Cargo Plane
why: A burning cargo plane trails smoke over the mountains; Trevor runs the hold and bails out.
